Title: Nitin and the Family

Cast

1. Nitin - 33 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Pallavi - 32 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Sonali - 55 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Nitin stands on the training ground. Pallavi and Sonali stand near him.]

Nitin: "Pallavi, what's the plan today?"

[Nitin practises sword fighting.]

Nitin: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Nitin draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Nitin: "That was fun!"

[Nitin mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Sonali: "This is amazing!"

[Nitin swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Pallavi (laughing): "Hey, look at that!"

[Nitin shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Sonali: "How beautiful!"

[Pallavi rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Pallavi (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Sonali: "Nitin, look over here."

[Nitin pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Nitin: "Oh wow!"

[Nitin sips red wine.]

Nitin: "Careful!"

[Nitin drinks a beer.]

Sonali (happily): "Yes, all right."

[Nitin staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Nitin (happily): "That was such a fun day!"
